title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
summary: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
summary: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.

title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
summary: While Tether's stated ceiling places its maximum exposure under $64 million, the incident underscores lingering counterparty risks in fiat gateway networks.

title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
summary: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

title: Bond volatility surges while bitcoin and Wall Street stay calm
summary: Bond volatility is at its highest since March, while the bitcoin VIX, BVIV and Wall Street's VIX remain near its yearly low.
